identity.title: Ubiquitous Molecular Outflows in z > 4 Massive, Dusty Galaxies. I. Sample Overview and Clumpy Structure in Molecular Outflows on 500 pc Scales

analysis_steps.goal: Extract integrated OH spectra and fit Gaussian profiles

method.value: Aperture photometry within region where continuum >3 sigma; fit one or two pairs of Gaussians with fixed doublet separation ~520 km/s and equal amplitudes; derive EW, v50, v84, vmax

evidence.quote: we fit the integrated spectra with one or two pairs of Gaussians depending on the complexity of the line profile for each source.

key_parameters.value: free params: continuum, absorption depth, velocity offset, width per component

evidence.quote: The free parameters are the continuum flux density and either one or two of each of the absorption depth, the velocity offset relative to the systemic, and Gaussian line width.

assumptions.value: constant continuum across the band; alternate-sideband continuum or SED used when few line-free channels

evidence.quote: We assume a constant continuum flux density across the relatively narrow bandwidth of these observations.
we fit the integrated spectra with one or two pairs of Gaussians depending on the complexity of the line profile for each source.

validation.value: Tested alternate-sideband continuum on sources with line-free bandwidth in both sidebands; no appreciable differences

evidence.quote: We tested this procedure using the sources with sufficient line-free bandwidth in both sidebands and find no appreciable differences in the OH fit parameters.

method.value: Outflow if OH absorption is more blueshifted than detected [CII] or CO emission; compared with v50<-50 km/s criterion

evidence.quote: we define a source as containing an outflow if it shows OH absorption more blueshifted than the detected \[CII\] or CO emission, which we expect to be a conservative definition.

assumptions.value: systemic redshift from [CII] (5 sources) or S/N-weighted stacked CO lines

evidence.quote: we instead stack the spectra of all available transitions of CO for each source, weighted by the S/N of each line.

validation.value: Binomial statistics for the detection rate; v50 alternative gives 7/11

evidence.quote: would still result in 7/11 sources being classified as showing outflows

analysis_steps.goal: Lens model continuum and reconstruct OH absorption components

method.value: Pixellated visibility-space lens modeling with SIE (+shear, multipoles) and gradient regularization; lens parameters from continuum then applied to OH velocity ranges

evidence.quote: We fit for the lensing potential using a Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) sampling algorithm.

key_parameters.value: visibilities averaged temporally unless binned visibility spans >10 m in uv

evidence.quote: which we average temporally unless doing so would cause a binned visibility to span more than 10m in the $uv$ plane

assumptions.value: Regularization strength set by maximizing Bayesian evidence for fixed lens parameters, iterated

evidence.quote: The best-fit strength of the regularization is determined by maximizing the Bayesian evidence given a fixed set of parameters for the lensing potential.

fitting.value: MCMC for lens potential; iterative regularization/MCMC; priors not stated

evidence.quote: we perform an iterative process of fitting for the regularization strength, MCMC fitting for the lens parameters, and re-fitting for the regularization strength until all parameters have converged.

validation.value: Deviance information criterion, negative-bowl check (>=10% of peak), mock point-source tests across source plane (recover fluxes to ~25%)

evidence.quote: This final test shows that even these weak signals are recoverable to $\approx$25% accuracy.

method.value: Covering fraction as fraction of pixels with detectable absorption where continuum S/N>10; Gini, M20, multiplicity on equivalent-width maps; MC noise for uncertainties

evidence.quote: measured from the equivalent width maps and for pixels where the continuum S/N$>$10

claims.hypothesis: Molecular outflows are common in z>4 DSFGs
claims.experiment: ALMA Band 8 OH 119 um absorption in 11 lensed SPT DSFGs, classified relative to [CII]/CO emission
claims.finding: Outflows have near-unity occurrence and large opening angles

evidence.quote: We find unambiguous evidence for outflows in 8/11 (73%) galaxies, more than tripling the number known at $z>4$.

claims.hypothesis: Outflows are clumpy on ~500 pc scales
claims.experiment: Lens reconstructions and Gini/M20/multiplicity metrics comparing absorption to continuum
claims.result: outflows clumpier than continuum by at least two metrics in all sources
claims.finding: Clumpy structure is common; clumps unresolved, expected 50-200 pc

evidence.quote: Lensing reconstructions reveal that 500pc-scale clumpy structures in the outflows are common.

claims.finding: [CII] is not a reliable molecular outflow tracer
